verdict.rationale: Fireflies offers webhook notifications on transcription completion and a Zapier integration that can auto-fetch transcripts on meeting events, plus a 'Rules Engine' described for admin automation of meeting access/privacy — all forms of event-triggered automation, but not a general-purpose user-defined rules engine for arbitrary AI-native actions. missing for 10: a documented in-product rules/automation builder for arbitrary triggers-and-actions (beyond admin privacy controls), and independent/hands-on confirmation of the Rules Engine's actual scope.
